_comment: ATLAS FlySky FS-i6S driving config. Read by atlas_flysky_teleop.py only when ATLAS_FLYSKY_DRIVE_ENABLED=1. It cannot arm until the owner has reviewed every line and set reviewed_by_owner to true. Channel numbers are the owner-verified mapping of 2026-10-29: CH1 right stick L-R, CH2 right stick U-D, CH3 left stick U-D (NOT self-centring on the FS-i6S, so not used for throttle), CH4 left stick L-R, CH5 SwA, CH6 SwB, CH7 SwC, CH8 SwD, CH9 VrA, CH10 VrB. Raw counts: switch up = 240, down = 1807; stick right/up = 1807. Owner layout 2026-10-29: throttle CH2 and steering CH1, both on the spring-centred right stick (releasing it stops and straightens; a diagonal push couples throttle and steering).
